headline: Citrini Research Bets on a ‘Treasury Twist’: Why the 30-Year Bond Could Rally
summary: Citrini Research predicts a Treasury twist in the market, with banks replacing the Fed as buyers of government debt, leading to a potential short squeeze on 30-year bonds.

headline: QUICK SPARK: $3.8B SPY Exodus Meets $3.7B QQQ Inflow in One Day
summary: QQQ attracted $3.67 billion in ETF inflows while SPY saw $3.82 billion in outflows, as semiconductor ETFs also drew strong investor demand.
